name_input: JAS Minchemin Speciality Solutions Private Limited
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records (page https://importkey.com/countries/india/jas-minchemin-speciality-solutions-private-limited, counter 'Total Shipments 7 Records detected', 5 rows actually displayed): "2025-08-20 | JAS MINCHEMIN SPECIALITY SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED | JSC KAUSTIK | SPL ZHFR 5300 XL COMPOUND 4 BATCHES (1 KG) | BOMBAY AIR CARGO, India | SHEREMETYEVO, Russia | 39019000 | BOL 6317458"; second export row: "2025-03-04 | JAS MINCHEMIN SPECIALITY SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED | JSC KAUSTIK | KURARAY SEPTON 8851 FFS - 10KGS BAG | Bombay Air, India | MOSCOW, RUSSIA | 40029990 | BOL 8708267". Both are small air consignments (1 kg / 10 kg bags) to a single counterparty, JSC Kaustik (Volgograd, Russia).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record found in accessible sources. Zauba Corp, TheCompanyCheck, Volza and Eximpedia returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable (connection refused), so no domestic-supply search could be completed. Registered address per ImportKey: "Flat No: 1002, A-Wing, Dosti Imperia Gracia, G B Road, Chitalsar Manpada, 400610" (residential-style office address, Maharashtra).
note: Actual export shipments exist and are documented with dates, destinations, HS codes and B/L numbers: 2 outbound air shipments to Russia (04.03.2025 HS 40029990; 20.08.2025 HS 39019000), both to JSC Kaustik. Declared HS 400299 matches the 04.03.2025 record (40029990); the 20.08.2025 record is HS 39019000, so the company ships across at least two HS codes — HS should be treated as multi-code, not a single 400299. The remaining 3 of 5 visible rows are inbound imports from JSC Kaustik (magnesium hydroxide, HS 28161010, marked FOC/sample), i.e. the company is a two-way trader with one Russian partner rather than a producer. Volumes are sample-scale (1 kg, 10 kg), so revenue/export value cannot be derived — null. Domestic supply evidence: not found, but the search was blocked by 403s and a dead search backend, so status is 'unknown', not 'none_found'. No rejection grounds: legal entity appears active in customs records as of 2025-12-19.
